summary: Kidnapping with ransom under Section 364A IPC; multiple appeals from P&H High Court dismissal; disclosure statements under Section 27 of Evidence Act; identification based on recovery evidence; standard of proof for kidnapping with ransom; adequacy of motive and corroboration; circumstantial evidence chain; eyewitness testimony consistency.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; convictions under Sections 364A, 392, 120B IPC upheld; life imprisonment and fines confirmed.
